scoring_justification: Recompute relative error of reported τ and G against the paper's analytical predictions (Eqs. 1-2); scoring is monotonic with error, includes monotonicity trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: analytical reference values for τ and G from paper Eqs. 1-2
hidden_assets.generation_method: compute τ and G using given formulas for required Ct and C2/Ct values; used as gold for relative error computation
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Derived directly from the paper's own analytical expressions, thus authentic to the paper's reported model.

outputs.description: Averaged effective shear strength τ and shear modulus G for each (Ct, C2/Ct) combination. The checker recomputes accuracy by comparing these values to the paper's analytical predictions and checking monotonicity trends.

output_contract.notes: The agent must run the full MCA pipeline; the analytical fitting stage is not required. The hidden checker uses the paper's analytical expressions (Eqs. 1-2) as reference curves and scores based on relative tolerance of the simulated values plus trend consistency.

steps.description: Check that ensemble-averaged effective shear strength τ and shear modulus G for required Ct and C2/Ct combinations are within 15% of paper's analytical predictions, and that monotonicity trends hold.
